images.view: Cinematic panoramic landscape seen from a low rocky ridge close to the colony, with the horizon in the upper half of the frame and plain bare rocky ground filling the lower third of the frame.
images.subject: In the middle distance, at the foot of a towering cliff, stands a cluster of far-future high-tech installations with domes and towers, spanning about a third of the frame width, their windows and floodlights glowing brightly.
images.detail: The colony and the sky above it share the frame, both large and clearly visible.
